hints.title: Polynomial Term Formatting Rules
hints.text: Each term requires an explicit leading sign, absolute coefficient, and conditional exponent notation.

hints.title: Conditional Exponent Syntax
hints.text: Power zero renders as constant, power one renders with X without caret, and powers above one render with caret.

hints.title: Descending Degree Concatenation
hints.text: Order terms by power descending and concatenate the resulting strings followed by equals zero.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```sql
WITH FormattedTerms AS (
    SELECT 
        power,
        CONCAT(
            CASE WHEN factor > 0 THEN '+' ELSE '-' END,
            ABS(factor),
            CASE 
                WHEN power = 0 THEN ''
                WHEN power = 1 THEN 'X'
                ELSE CONCAT('X^', power)
            END
        ) AS term_str
    FROM Terms
)
SELECT 
    CONCAT(GROUP_CONCAT(term_str ORDER BY power DESC SEPARATOR ''), '=0') AS equation
FROM FormattedTerms;
```

complexity.time: O(N log N) sorting terms by descending power and string concatenation
variables: N: number of terms in polynomial
complexity.notes: Signs (+ or -) must be explicitly formatted for every term, and power 0 or 1 have special abbreviations.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Standard numeric concatenation misses explicit plus signs on positive terms or incorrect carets on power one.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Ordering terms by power descending before group concatenation formats the polynomial in standard mathematical order.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should apply conditional string formatting and concatenate terms in descending power order.

solutions.code:
WITH FormattedTerms AS (
    SELECT 
        power,
        (CASE WHEN factor > 0 THEN '+' ELSE '-' END) ||
        CAST(ABS(factor) AS TEXT) ||
        (CASE 
            WHEN power = 0 THEN ''
            WHEN power = 1 THEN 'X'
            ELSE 'X^' || CAST(power AS TEXT)
        END) AS term_str
    FROM Terms
)
SELECT 
    STRING_AGG(term_str, '' ORDER BY power DESC) || '=0' AS equation
FROM FormattedTerms;
solutions.approach: PostgreSQL window ranking and aggregation solution.
